historical_record.description: Four vacant residential buildings with nine dwelling units stood on the three lots at the top of the Filbert Steps, with a vacant noncomplying structure in the rear yard of one of them.
The City Planning Commission granted conditional-use authorization, 5-0 and with conditions, for seven dwelling units on the 7,536-square-foot parcel at the top of the Filbert Steps (Motion 13782).
